one_minute_value_explanation: AOF can now turn its next-task judgment into a bounded Japanese reproduction drill: what is happening, what options exist, which task is selected, why it matters, what evidence to check, whether to proceed, and what the human should do next.
thirty_second_version_delta: v11.0 let AOF observe GitHub read-only and select a task; v11.1 makes that decision reproducible by a first-time or external operator within five minutes.
product_review_trigger: If the operator still asks what the selected task means or why it is most important, reopen product value explanation and reproduction packet design.
not_proven: This does not prove actual third-party adoption, market value, semantic truth, productivity gain, or broad UX quality.
